create_memstat_monitor: create a MemStat monitor instance with a collection interval and job UUID
run_memstat_collector: run the MemStat collector thread to periodically sample /proc/meminfo memory statistics
collect_memory_stats: collect memory counters like MemTotal, MemFree, MemAvailable, SwapTotal, and SwapFree from /proc/meminfo
terminate_memstat_collector: terminate the MemStat collector thread and join it to stop memory monitoring
review_memstat_class: review the MemStat class to understand how it parses /proc/meminfo and applies unit multipliers
